statement: let reps (n : ℕ) := (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p)); let D (X : ℕ) := (Finset.Ico X (2 * X)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n); let bad (X : ℕ) := (D X).filter (fun n => (reps n).card = 0); let exc (N : ℕ) := (Finset.range (N + 1)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ (reps n).card = 0); ∀ (K N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → (∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → n < 2 ^ K → Even n → (reps n).Nonempty) → (∀ j : ℕ, K ≤ j → ((bad (2 ^ j)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * ((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ)) → ((exc N).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε * (N : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: If every eligible even number below 2ᴷ has a representation and each later block [2ʲ,2ʲ⁺¹) has at most ε2ʲ exceptions, then there are at most 2εN exceptions through N.
plain_statement.zh: 若所有小于 2ᴷ 且至少为 4 的偶数都有表示，且此后的每个区间 [2ʲ,2ʲ⁺¹) 至多有 ε2ʲ 个例外，则直到 N 的例外数至多为 2εN。

brief.en: Count an exception when the finite set of prime summands p with n−p prime is empty. Split at each dyadic midpoint, then use the least power of two strictly above N, which is at most 2N for positive N.
brief.zh: 若所有满足 n−p 也为素数的素数加数 p 构成的有限集为空，则将 n 计为例外。逐个倍增区间在中点拆分。对正整数 N，严格大于 N 的最小二次幂至多为 2N。
